_comment: Consumer adapter config for dispatch_launch.py --adapters. One entry per page role: the command that executes that role's page request. {request} is the page-request JSON path, {result} is where the consumer must write its page-result JSON, {work_dir} is the dispatch directory. A result is accepted only when it validates and echoes its request exactly (collect_launch_receipts rules). S49-08 assembly (this revision): five roles are wired to the S49 consumer wrappers shipped in 49-signature-funnel/scripts/ (landing via landing_bridge.py, product_selection via selection_wrapper.py, upsell_1 and upsell_2 via separate upsell_wrapper.py invocations, thank_you via translate_thank_you_result.py); the /path/to/ entries keep this file's example convention and are replaced with real install paths at deployment. checkout is NOT wired and its placeholder entry is removed by design: per CR-S49-003 the order form is the native Convert and Flow form installed by Skill 06, never a dispatch adapter. downsell_1 is NOT wired and its placeholder entry is removed: no consumer exists until Skill 81 lands on main. A role with no adapter entry makes dispatch fail closed for that role rather than pretend. Per-role notes: landing also needs the bridge config named by --bridge-config (Skill 71 tree root plus the landing operator values; the bridge refuses to run when any operator value is missing) and consent statements reach the popup only via landing.consent_statements in that config. Upsell runs need the operator-staged work-dir inputs named in the command (launch.json, the per-instance copy document, the verified journey state, the enrichment sidecar) and the Skill 80 tree at the --produce path. product_selection takes per-launch --launch and --mappings inputs (that launch's approved record and its S44/S79 native mapping rows), which must be set for the launch before dispatching. RETIREMENT: when Skill 78's first candidate after PR #2158 lands with the native emitter fix (output file path, request-echoed page_id and input_hash, outcome relocated), replace the product_selection entry with the native entrypoint and delete selection_wrapper.py. thank_you needs the Skill 82 thank-you result document and its companion run manifest in the work dir, and the dispatch run session id in --author-session.
